page.notes: Some words in the entries are faint or uncertain; these are marked [?] where they stand. The right-hand part of each line is clear. The entries under "Deus" continue beyond the end of this part. The handwritten "597" at the top right is manuscript, not printed, so it is left out. The Greek word after "an solus" is hard to read; the reading given is doubtful. "in mundo selem" may be a misprint for "sedem"; left as printed. Some spellings are kept as printed where the scan is unclear (e.g. "aqualiter", "probitur"). The page ends mid-word at "dica-", so there is no catchword.
